messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Acme - procurement readiness & commercial path

Hi Jill / Tom —

Great to chat earlier — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

What we covered:
- High-level use case: inferencing for customer support reranking and summarization (initial scope 2 models, ~50k tokens/day).
- Success metrics: 99th latency < 300ms for single-request responses, monthly cost target ~ $6k–8k.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + dedicated VPC optional (you asked about on-prem later).

Commercial / procurement questions we flagged:
1) Preferred billing path: PO (standard for enterprise) vs. procurement via cloud marketplace vs. corporate card?
2) Do you need a formal SOW or will a PO + SOW-lite be sufficient to get started?
3) Procurement contacts and any internal timelines (e.g., monthly/quarterly procurement windows)?

Attachments: Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (high-level checklist for legal/procurement to speed review).

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm PO path, I’ll loop in our Finance/Legal (Marcus) and draft a basic SOW for your review.
- If marketplace is preferable, we can provide the marketplace SKU and estimate to speed payment.
- If procurement wants an initial statement of work, I can send a first draft by EOD Thursday.

Can you confirm preferred billing route and whom to loop in on your side?

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
https://redwood.com

From: Jill Porter <jill.porter@acmecorp.com>

Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 18:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Acme - procurement readiness & commercial path

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few notes from procurement/legal side: 

- We generally prefer a PO for anything over $5k/month. Marketplace is an option but procurement often pushes for PO so we have a single vendor track.
- Procurement will need a short SOW + your standard T&C language to start.
- I attached our PO template and a short checklist of required fields.

Can you send the SOW draft and an expected billing contact (name + email)? Once we have the SOW and pricing, procurement can generate a PO. Legal may want to redline the SOW/T&C — that’s our normal flow.

Jill Porter
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
jill.porter@acmecorp.com

Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.pdf

- This SOW is intentionally short (scope + SLAs + pricing summary) to minimize legal review time.
- Billing contact: Sandra Liu (Finance) — sandra.liu@redwood.com / +1-415-555-0189.

Can you share an estimated timeline for procurement/legal review so we can plan onboarding? Happy to hop on a quick call with your procurement/legal team tomorrow or early next week to walk through the SOW.

Marissa

Hi Marissa — quick update: 
- Legal has the SOW and is doing an initial redline pass; this is the blocker right now. They flagged a couple of standard clauses (indemnity and data residency language) that our counsel is discussing with Finance.
- Procurement needs final billing contact / tax info to issue the PO (we have the suggested billing contact but will need tax ID and W-9).
- Marketplace is faster but our compliance team prefers PO for committed spend.

We expect to have legal comments back by Friday EOD. Once we have redlines, can you confirm whether Redwood typically accepts the standard redline (or if Marcus needs to review)? If legal signs off, procurement will generate a PO quickly and route it to Finance.

I’ll follow up if anything else changes.

Jill
